tools.name: pw.status
tools.description: Return full-client connection and character state.

tools.name: pw.navigation_scan
tools.description: Read-only polar ground-feasibility map around the current character through stock CDR. Rows include direction, reachable distance, end position, elevation change and ground normal; server correction telemetry remains in state.

tools.name: pw.set_mode
tools.description: Mirror the external controller mode into the exact current headless role. IDLE revokes implicit stock auto-delivery; only QUEST permits it.

tools.name: pw.move_to
tools.description: Move through stock host-player movement. stock_autopath=1 matches the GUI complex-map/task-link route even without an NPC binding. Optional npc_template_id plus task_id retain the stock quest-NPC trace transition.

tools.name: pw.stop_move
tools.description: Stop current character movement through the full client.

tools.name: pw.jump
tools.description: Jump (same path as the Space key; obeys sitting/water/ground rules).

tools.name: pw.chat_send
tools.description: Send public chat through the game session.

tools.name: pw.whisper
tools.description: Send private chat through the game session.

tools.name: pw.chat_recent
tools.description: Return manual chat history plus the bounded numeric autonomous-chat event stream.

tools.name: pw.chat_reply_template
tools.description: Send one fixed reviewed whisper template against an exact numeric observed-message binding. No target or text input is accepted.

tools.name: pw.nearby
tools.description: List nearby monsters, players and loot the agent can perceive without render.

tools.name: pw.select_target
tools.description: Select a target by object id; pass 0 to clear the current target.

tools.name: pw.get_target
tools.description: Return the current selected target id in the state snapshot.

tools.name: pw.normal_attack
tools.description: Start a normal attack on the current target, or on an optional target id.

tools.name: pw.cast_skill
tools.description: Cast a skill by id on the current target, or on an optional target id.

tools.name: pw.auto_combat_status
tools.description: Return initialization, runtime state and exact configuration of the stock client AutoKillMonster Lua policy.

tools.name: pw.auto_combat_configure
tools.description: Configure the stock client auto-combat dialog numerically. attack_skill -1 is normal attack; nonnegative combo values address an existing client combo macro.

tools.name: pw.auto_combat_start
tools.description: Start the configured stock AutoKillMonster policy after validating its action bindings and weapon endurance. Optional target_id and target_template_id form one exact observed monster constraint; both must be supplied together.

tools.name: pw.auto_combat_stop
tools.description: Stop the stock AutoKillMonster policy and clear its queued player actions.

tools.name: pw.use_item
tools.description: Use one item from an exact observed main-inventory snapshot; count is the observed stack count before this one use.

tools.name: pw.pickup
tools.description: Pick up a ground matter by its id (from pw.nearby).

tools.name: pw.gather
tools.description: Gather a loaded mine by its matter id (from pw.nearby) through the normal client gather path.

tools.name: pw.revive
tools.description: Revive the character when dead. method: town (default), item or accept.

tools.name: pw.inventory
tools.description: List items in the main inventory pack with slot, templateId, count and name.

tools.name: pw.follow
tools.description: Follow a player or NPC by id through the host-player follow path.

tools.name: pw.skills
tools.description: List learned/progression skills and, while a normal trainer NPC service is current, an atomic numeric trainer snapshot and revision.

tools.name: pw.learn_skill
tools.description: Send one stock trainer learn request from an exact fresh pw.skills trainer binding. Completion requires a later higher learned level.

tools.name: pw.team_status
tools.description: Return an exact numeric team snapshot, pending invitation bindings, member HP/MP and host form.

tools.name: pw.team_invite
tools.description: Invite one exact loaded player using a fresh team revision and monotonic operation id.

tools.name: pw.team_accept
tools.description: Accept one exact pending leader/sequence invitation binding once.

tools.name: pw.role_list
tools.description: Role-admin only. Return the authoritative character-select role list with slot usage. Retryable while the list is still loading.

tools.name: pw.role_create
tools.description: Role-admin only. Create one character (deferred, idempotent by operation_id). Re-send the same arguments and operation_id to poll the outcome.

tools.name: pw.role_delete
tools.description: Role-admin only. Schedule a deferred reversible deletion of one owned role (idempotent by operation_id). Re-send to poll the outcome.

tools.name: pw.role_undelete
tools.description: Role-admin only. Cancel a pending deletion of one owned role before its delete_time (idempotent by operation_id). Re-send to poll the outcome.

tools.name: pw.cast_support_skill
tools.description: Cast one vetted learned friendly heal or buff on an exact same-instance team member using fresh HP, skill and team bindings.

tools.name: pw.equipment
tools.description: List currently equipped items with slot, templateId, count and name.

tools.name: pw.equipment_advice
tools.description: Return numeric-only compatible weapon and armor rankings plus exact inventory/equipment revisions. No localized-name heuristic is used.

tools.name: pw.allocate_attributes
tools.description: Allocate every currently observed free character point once through the stock character packet. Exact role, instance, profession, level and before-values are mandatory; completion requires a later authoritative snapshot.

tools.name: pw.equip_best_weapon
tools.description: Equip one deterministic best compatible weapon upgrade from an exact advice snapshot. Closes an active NPC service through the stock client path before equipping.

tools.name: pw.equip_best_armor
tools.description: Equip one deterministic best compatible armor upgrade from an exact advice snapshot; repeat only after observing fresh revisions.

tools.name: pw.npc_talk
tools.description: Talk to / open the service of a nearby NPC by its object id (from pw.nearby), through the normal client talk path.

tools.name: pw.npc_service
tools.description: Prepare or inspect the active NPC service context. service values include shop/buy_from_npc, sell_to_npc, repair, heal, transmit, skill/learn_skill, craft, task_out and task_in.

tools.name: pw.npc_buy
tools.description: Buy once from an exact observed NPC catalog snapshot. All context, revision and price-bound fields are mandatory.

tools.name: pw.npc_sell
tools.description: Sell once from an exact observed main-inventory snapshot. Packet price is always recomputed locally.

tools.name: pw.npc_repair
tools.description: Repair once from an exact observed equipment snapshot. scope 1 is the equipment pack; slot and item_id are additionally required when all is false.

tools.name: pw.npc_heal
tools.description: Use the active NPC heal service once and await an authoritative HP change.

tools.name: pw.npc_craft
tools.description: Disabled fail-closed until an authoritative recipe, ingredient, inventory-revision, cost and count contract is available.

tools.name: pw.service_directory
tools.description: List nearest NPC service coordinates from the stock current-instance coordinate table without opening a service, including skill trainers.

tools.name: pw.travel_status
tools.description: Return numeric known-waypoint state and destinations exported by the current NPC transmit service.

tools.name: pw.npc_transmit
tools.description: Use one exact destination binding exported by pw.travel_status; source instance, NPC, service, waypoint binding and fee ceiling are mandatory.

tools.name: pw.quest_status
tools.description: List the player's current quests and currently deliverable quest templates.

tools.name: pw.quest_accept
tools.description: Accept one exact current NPC task-out offer. Fresh callers bind the action task, service row, NPC object/template, service and offer snapshot; legacy task_id-only calls fail closed when the action is ambiguous.

tools.name: pw.quest_abandon
tools.description: Request abandonment of one exact current active quest root through the stock task interface. Role, instance, selected step and monotonic operation bindings are mandatory; success remains pending until quest_status proves the root absent.

tools.name: pw.quest_client_action
tools.description: Perform the exact active stock client-owned quest action: a template-owned ordinary simple-client pose, or a reach-site completion-dialog acknowledgement after native region validation. This mutating tool accepts no pose, target or emotion input and requires enhanced exact-role authority.

tools.name: pw.quest_turn_in
tools.description: Turn in / finish an active quest through the normal NPC return-task or confirm-task path. Call pw.npc_talk first for NPC turn-ins.
